title: HeroLoop enemy catalogue and rank identity

ranks.label: Normal
ranks.visualContract: small clean silhouette; no aura or prestige frame

ranks.label: Veteran
ranks.visualContract: reinforced equipment; silver chevron; no ambient particles

ranks.label: Elite
ranks.visualContract: changed equipment silhouette; gold frame; one persistent affix mark

ranks.label: Epic
ranks.visualContract: named champion; unique silhouette additions; title banner and bounded signature aura

ranks.label: Boss
ranks.visualContract: dedicated boss frame; large health presentation; telegraphed mechanics

ranks.label: Dungeon Boss
ranks.visualContract: arena-scale identity; phase presentation; persistent mechanic and disclosed modifier

families.label: Raiders
families.visualIdentity: patched leather, scavenged metal, hooks and improvised ranged weapons

families.label: Undead
families.visualIdentity: broken armour, exposed bone, grave cloth and cold soul light

families.label: Beasts
families.visualIdentity: low predatory silhouettes, readable claws, fangs, wings and web organs

families.label: Oozes
families.visualIdentity: translucent mass, embedded debris and one strong elemental core

families.label: Warclans
families.visualIdentity: broad silhouettes, heavy weapons, trophies and elemental war paint

families.label: Constructs
families.visualIdentity: stone or plate geometry, exposed joints and one luminous rune engine

families.label: Voidborn
families.visualIdentity: broken anatomy, floating fragments and negative-space rifts

families.label: The Fallen
families.visualIdentity: ruined ceremonial armour, fractured halos, wings and god-shard light
